records.definition_en: Clutch actuator position control error
records.translation_ar: خلل التحكم بموضع مشغل القابض
symptoms: Poor/no gear shifting or clutch operation

causes.hypothesis: TCU, actuator or related mechatronic failure, case-dependent
Damaged harness/connectors or worn selector contacts
Unfinished adaptation or incorrect configuration, depending on DTC

diagnostic_steps: Identify exact gearbox family, TCU part number, ECU software and VIN before applying code meaning
Record fault memory, battery state, freeze frame, available actuator and selector parameters
Inspect appropriate actuator/TCU, selector contacts and harness, then compare actual vs commanded state
Re-test system with authorized calibration/learning where required, and repair only demonstrated faults

records.definition_en: Gearbox control system operation fault
records.translation_ar: خلل تشغيل نظام التحكم بناقل الحركة
symptoms: Poor/no gear shifting or clutch operation

causes.hypothesis: TCU, actuator or related mechatronic failure, case-dependent
Damaged harness/connectors or worn selector contacts
Unfinished adaptation or incorrect configuration, depending on DTC

diagnostic_steps: Identify exact gearbox family, TCU part number, ECU software and VIN before applying code meaning
Record fault memory, battery state, freeze frame, available actuator and selector parameters
Inspect appropriate actuator/TCU, selector contacts and harness, then compare actual vs commanded state
Re-test system with authorized calibration/learning where required, and repair only demonstrated faults
